title: Sunday Dinner Show Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
blurb:
Enjoy a delightful evening on the Sunday Dinner Show Cruise, where you can savor a delicious Italian buffet while listening to live music featuring hits from the 70s, 80s, and today. This two-hour cruise on Lake Minnetonka offers a relaxing atmosphere with free unlimited soft drinks and a cash bar for your convenience. Perfect for families or anyone looking to unwind with good food and great music. Gather your friends and family for a memorable night out on the water.

- Two-hour cruise with live music entertainment
- Italian buffet menu with chicken fettuccine and dessert bars
- Free unlimited soft drinks and a full cash bar available
- Ideal for families and groups looking for a fun night out
